name: summaraize
description: Free bring-your-own-key WordPress summaries with OpenAI or Google Gemini.

scripts.fix: sh -c 'if [ -x vendor/bin/phpcbf ]; then vendor/bin/phpcbf -d memory_limit=512M -d error_reporting="E_ALL&~E_DEPRECATED" --standard=phpcs.xml.dist --extensions=php .; else phpcbf -d memory_limit=512M -d error_reporting="E_ALL&~E_DEPRECATED" --standard=phpcs.xml.dist --extensions=php .; fi'
scripts.check: sh -c 'if [ -x vendor/bin/phpcs ]; then vendor/bin/phpcs -d memory_limit=512M -d error_reporting="E_ALL&~E_DEPRECATED" --standard=phpcs.xml.dist --extensions=php .; else phpcs -d memory_limit=512M -d error_reporting="E_ALL&~E_DEPRECATED" --standard=phpcs.xml.dist --extensions=php .; fi' > check.txt
scripts.phpmd: sh -c 'if [ -x vendor/bin/phpmd ]; then vendor/bin/phpmd . text phpmd.xml --exclude vendor,node_modules,.codex-backups; else phpmd . text phpmd.xml --exclude vendor,node_modules,.codex-backups; fi' > phpmd.txt
scripts.dist: sh -c 'PLUGIN_DIR="$(basename "$PWD")"; DIST_DIR="$PWD/dist"; STAGE_DIR="$DIST_DIR/$PLUGIN_DIR"; ZIP_PATH="$DIST_DIR/$PLUGIN_DIR.zip"; rm -rf "$DIST_DIR"; mkdir -p "$STAGE_DIR"; cp -R admin includes languages public "$STAGE_DIR"; cp index.php LICENSE.txt readme.txt summaraize.php uninstall.php wpml-config.xml "$STAGE_DIR"; cd "$DIST_DIR" && zip -rq "$ZIP_PATH" "$PLUGIN_DIR"'
scripts.test:local: sh -c 'if [ -x vendor/bin/phpunit ]; then vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml.dist; elif command -v phpunit >/dev/null 2>&1; then phpunit -c phpunit.xml.dist; else echo "phpunit is not installed. Run composer install to add project test dependencies."; exit 127; fi'

author: James Wilson
